title: Best Sitcoms to Stream Right Now
intro: The sitcom is the most durable format in television history - thirty years of multi-camera dominance, then a decade of single-camera reinvention, and now a streaming era that has produced its own shortlist of genuine classics. These are the shows that justify the format's survival.

picks.title: Fleabag
picks.one_line: Two six-episode series and a performance from Phoebe Waller-Bridge that changed what television comedy is allowed to feel - grief wearing a smirk, perfectly assembled.

picks.title: Ted Lasso
picks.one_line: An American football coach coaching English soccer - deceptively warm, structurally smart, and Season 2's handling of mental health is the best the genre has ever managed the subject.

picks.title: The Bear
picks.one_line: A Michelin-starred chef running a Chicago beef sandwich shop - the most stressful sitcom ever made, and the most emotionally precise depiction of professional perfectionism on any platform.

picks.title: Abbott Elementary
picks.one_line: A Philadelphia public school mockumentary that treats its teachers as heroes without irony - the best traditional comedy on American television since The Office.

picks.title: What We Do in the Shadows
picks.one_line: Four vampires sharing a Staten Island house in 2019 - Taika Waititi's mockumentary conceit stretched across six seasons without losing a single joke.

picks.title: Schitt's Creek
picks.one_line: A wealthy family stripped of everything, dropped in a small town - the character arcs over six seasons constitute one of the most satisfying comedic long-games in television.

picks.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
picks.one_line: The most competently crafted ensemble cop comedy in modern television - eight seasons of jokes that respect both the characters and the audience.

faq.q: Which sitcom on this list is best for a single-sitting binge?
faq.a: Fleabag's two seasons total 12 episodes under 30 minutes each - it is designed to be consumed in one sitting and delivers a complete emotional arc in roughly five hours. Schitt's Creek Season 1 is the other compact on-ramp if you want to test the longer run.

faq.q: Which of these is the best entry point if you only try one?
faq.a: Ted Lasso for warmth and momentum, or Abbott Elementary if you want a workplace mockumentary that lands its jokes fast. Fleabag is the critical favourite but starts spikier - the emotional turn in its second season is the reason it tops most lists.
